resources.string: Paste a YouTube link. The app downloads the audio — no file upload needed.
Paste the lyrics here. Leave empty and the cloud will write them for you.
Logs copied — paste them in chat.
Nothing logged yet — try a download first.
The editor and render come in the next trial — for now this proves the YouTube download and the cloud draft work.

The draft runs on your Modal backend (the same one the desktop app uses). This app can’t deploy one. Paste one line: your backend URL and your API key, separated by a space — like the KaraokeNow ReVanced setup.
Paste the backend URL and the API key on one line, like: https://…modal.run your-key
The backend URL must start with https://
That line has no API key. Paste the URL and the key together, separated by a space.
Type your Modal workspace name (the username on your Modal account) and the app will build your backend URL for you.
Type your Modal workspace name first.
That doesn’t look like a Modal workspace name — just the username, no spaces or https://.
That URL is your KaraokeGen backend. Add your API key after it above, then tap Save.
That URL is a backend, but the server has no API key set — it won’t work until the backend is redeployed with one.
Couldn’t reach that URL — check the workspace name and your connection.
That URL answered (HTTP %1$d). It might be a backend — add your API key after it above, then tap Save.
Couldn’t check for updates — check your connection and try again.
Tap Update to download and install. Your data and settings are kept.
Allow this app to install updates first, then tap Update again.
